tldr: Moon through the 3rd house brings focus to communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
body: Moon transiting the 3rd house stirs communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. For about two to three days, emotion, instinct, and immediate need move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a fast emotional transit: it shows what needs care today, not necessarily what needs to define the whole season.
business: Moon supports writing, messaging, and local connection: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Mood-driven choices, insecurity, or scattered attention or reactive speech.
advice: Tend the feeling in the 3rd house deliberately. Work with communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
